lateral_torso_line_topology.vertical_line_count_and_spacing: 11 distinct white vertical line segments observed. Spacing is generally uniform across the central torso, with narrowing gaps between the posterior-most three lines.
lateral_torso_line_topology.discontinuity_mapping: The 3rd, 5th, and 7th lines (counting from posterior to anterior) exhibit fragmentation into isolated spots near the ventral boundary of the torso.

posterior_constellation_clusters.spatial_cluster_density: Low-density cluster of approximately 4-5 white spots located on the lower haunch, ventrally to the posterior vertical stripes.

other_distinctive_markers: Prominent white facial markings including two distinct spots between the eyes and a horizontal white band above the muzzle; large ovate ears with dark interior pigmentation and white tufts at the base.
